info.title: Narai tool registry
info.description: Register an organization's tools, upload their versions (a manifest and every file it lists, each checked against its digest), and launch a draft in development with a single-use id that names no learner. Sign in with the CLI (OAuth 2.1, PKCE) or a CI token bound to one tool.

get.description: The organisations the caller may develop tools for, with their publisher when they have one (a token: its one).

files.description: every file the manifest lists, each with its path as the filename

post.description: A CI token for this tool in this environment (`tool:` scopes): the token is in this answer and nowhere else.

A development launch of one version: the id a frame redeems once. Its maker is kept server-side; the tool, which
redeems it, learns the version and the preset only.
The frame's side: the launch id, once, for what it opens. No session and no person: the id is the credential.

get.description: A key the tool kept in this launch.

put.description: Keep a key in this launch, or rewrite it.

delete.description: Remove a key from this launch (done whether or not it was there).

token.title: Token
token.description: shown once: only its SHA-256 is kept

Refusal.title: Refusal
Refusal.description: A 4xx: `error` is the code, `message` its sentence; an upload's refusal lists its `reasons`.

value.title: Value
value.description: Any JSON, at most 16384 bytes of it compact
